Online store as a Telegram Mini App

A full store without leaving Telegram: filters, product pages, cart and payment, with no app to download. An MVP in 4–7 weeks, from UZS 60 mln; the full version in 10–16 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Mini App with catalogue, search, filters, cart and checkout with Click, Payme or Uzum
  • Bot for order notifications
  • Admin panel for products and orders
What the full version adds
  • Stock sync with 1C or your marketplace cabinet
  • Customer accounts and order history
  • Loyalty and promo codes
  • Recommendations
  • Analytics
  • Product sharing to chats
  • The same backend ready for a website or app later

What we need from you

  • A company Telegram account for the bot
  • The list of products or services with prices
  • A person who takes the orders

Questions

What does “Online store as a Telegram Mini App” cost?
The MVP costs $5,000–10,000 (UZS 60–121 mln), the full version $14,000–32,000 (UZS 168–385 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Online store as a Telegram Mini App” take?
The MVP takes 4–7 weeks, the full version 10–16 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
A company Telegram account for the bot; The list of products or services with prices; A person who takes the orders.
